title: Readiness
intro: An early-warning view of the sequencing rules: current state before solution, outcome before activity, and the gates before launch. It approves nothing.

sequencing.title: Sequencing
sequencing.intro: Whether initiatives may enter the portfolio and be launched now.

submit.yes: Initiatives can be submitted to the portfolio.
submit.no: Initiatives cannot be submitted to the portfolio yet.

blocker.generic: A sequencing rule is not met.
blocker.initiative__g1_not_approved: Case for change not yet approved (G1): leadership agreement on problem, baseline and material value pools is required before an initiative enters the portfolio.
blocker.initiative__direction_not_approved: North Star, outcomes and target state not yet approved.

diagnostic.title: Current state before solution
diagnostic.intro: Diagnose economics, customer, operations, capability and technology before prescribing initiatives. An area is covered when each of its T01 dimensions states current state, root cause, impact and confidence.
diagnostic.allCovered: All five diagnostic areas are covered.

dispensation.inheritedCounts: Inherited approval of {{gate}}: verified and accepted; counts for sequencing (the gate itself stays not approved in this product).
dispensation.inheritedPending: Inherited approval of {{gate}}: pending verification; it does not count yet.
dispensation.waiverActive: Waiver of {{gate}} for launch: accepted (the gate is not approved).
dispensation.waiverPending: Waiver of {{gate}} for launch: pending a decision; it does not count yet.

gates.title: Product gates G1-G4
gates.intro: Gate status as decided in this product. Inherited approvals and waivers are shown separately and never as an approval.
